title: console: linking a social/OIDC account that is already linked to another user, or that cannot be linked, still brings the signed-in person back with no word
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nWoa1Ze1QzjRTSYXD

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named producer. The #33063 os-dev read it on the vendor code, not live (report 6885304558, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class a), and it surfaced beside PR #33496.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/apps/console` auth pages + `@object-ui/i18n`). Grade p3, self-graded by the seat under the maintainer's 「定级你可以自己决定」: a refused link says nothing, but no data is wrong and the person can retry.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open account_already_linked_to_different_user` and `unable_to_link_account` find only #33063 (the sibling `email_does_not_match` code).

## 维护者速读

已登录用户在账号设置里关联第三方（社交 / OIDC）账号时，如果该第三方账号已经关联到别的用户，或者关联失败，better-auth 会带着错误码回到 Console，但页面什么都不说。#33063（PR #33496）只给「邮箱不一致」这一种拒绝加了提示，这两种同族的拒绝还是没有任何提示。

## Producer

- better-auth 1.7.12 `linkOAuthAccount` (`oauth2/link-account.mjs`) refuses a signed-in link with `account_already_linked_to_different_user` or `unable_to_link_account`. It redirects to the same Console login error URL as `email_does_not_match`.
- After PR #33496, the console keeps only the link codes it has a sentence for (`SIGNED_IN_LINK_REFUSALS`) and shows them through `LinkRefusalNotice`. These two codes have no entry, so the person lands back with no notice.

## Acceptance

- Both codes reach the signed-in person as one persistent, translated notice, through the same path PR #33496 adds: one `SIGNED_IN_LINK_REFUSALS` entry and one key in all 11 locales per code. The wording says what happened and what to do; it names no other user.
- Pin through the real App, as #33063's pins do, for each code under `en` and `zh-Hans`. CONTROL: `email_does_not_match` still shows its own sentence, and an unknown code still shows nothing new.
- Measure each code live, or on the vendor code if live is out of reach, and say which in the PR.
- ⛔ Lands after PR #33496 (same files).
